Manage link-local now applies to Agent builtin endpoints independently of configured IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, including after the last configured IPv6 address is removed. Stable per-plan/endpoint addresses, explicit manual addresses, management-off restoration, and external ownership remain unchanged. WireGuard adds the generated peer /128 without widening existing IPv6 allowances. UI, CLI, and VTY wording reflects the independent policy.

Update endpoint agents to v0.5.20 for the new behavior. Runtime configurations affected by this change require command protocol 8; unchanged configurations retain their existing requirements. No database migration or saved-plan rewrite is required. FOU transport-family restrictions and OpenVPN native configuration behavior are unchanged.
